name: diag_pilot_T0_retry3_preflight_01
command:
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import pbs_black_retry as b
r=Path.cwd().resolve()
guard=r/'results/diag_pilot_T0_retry2_black_guard_01.json'
gref={'file':str(guard.relative_to(r)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(guard.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
gdata,_=b.logged(r,gref)
b.require(gdata['_meta']['exit_code']==0,'Original strict guard failed')
proof=gdata['metrics']['strict_black_gate_proof']
path,body=b.file_ref(r,proof['original_payload'],'logs/pbs');payload=json.loads(body)
b.require(proof['job_id']=='709961.hopper-m-02' and payload['name']=='smoke_e2e_pilot_T0_s0_01_retry2','Not original T0 black job')
name='smoke_e2e_pilot_T0_s0_01_retry3';command=list(payload['command'])
command[command.index('--name')+1]=name
b.require(command[command.index('--timeout-seconds')+1]=='15536','Original driver bound differs')
command[command.index('--timeout-seconds')+1]='15536'
binding=b.validate_request_host(r,host='hopper-28',retry_of=proof['job_id'],evidence_path=gref['file'],evidence_sha256=gref['sha256'],name=name,command=command,task='T01',group='E2Epilot',gpus=1,wall_seconds=15600)
submit=['python3','scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py','--name',name,'--task','T01','--budget-group','E2Epilot','--gpus','1','--walltime','04:20:00','--host','hopper-28','--retry-of',proof['job_id'],'--black-retry-evidence',gref['file'],'--black-retry-evidence-sha256',gref['sha256'],'--',*command]
diag='diag_submit_'+name
logged=['python3','-u','scripts/run_logged.py','--name',diag,'--seed','0','--','python3','-m','src.tools.record_command','--name',diag,'--',*submit]
print('ORIGINAL_PILOT_RETRY_PREFLIGHT_JSON: '+json.dumps({'strict_guard':gref,'host_authorization':binding,'wall_seconds':15600,'driver_seconds':15536,'unchanged_population_and_holdout':True,'submitted':False},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print('ORIGINAL_SUBMIT_ARGV_JSON: '+json.dumps(logged),flush=True)
